title: The Strongest Insect Ever Measured Fits on Your Fingernail
subject: dung beetle

scenes.text: The strongest insect ever measured fits on your fingernail.
It's a horned dung beetle. Scientists hitched it to a tiny sled and watched what it could drag.
It pulled one thousand, one hundred and forty-one times its own body weight.
For a person, that's like lifting six full double-decker buses.
It uses that strength underground, in tunnels, shoving rivals out of the way.
The strongest insect alive. And it spends its life in dung.

description:
The strongest insect ever measured fits on your fingernail.
A horned dung beetle pulled 1,141 times its own body weight, the equivalent of a person lifting six double-decker buses.
Would you have guessed a dung beetle?
first_comment: The study was done by Rob Knell and Leigh Simmons and published in Proceedings of the Royal Society B. Which animal would you guess is next strongest for its size?
